newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNB propels Manila shares to sharply lower close.
newsitem.headline: PNB propels Manila shares to sharply lower close.

text.p: * Main index fell by 2.60 percent to 2,962.60
lower on Friday, after early heavy selling in Philippine
Bank spread to other major counters, traders said.
"The market overreacted when PNB fell. It was used as an excuse to get out when there is really no major reason to do so," said Jonas Ferrer, research head at Pryce Securities.
The main index fell 79.18 points or 2.60 percent to end at 2,962.60, just off its intra-day low of 2,960.
PNB closed 87.50 pesos lower at 322.50 after it announced yesterday its nine-month earnings were just four percent up on the same 1995 period, a result one labelled "dismal".

Other large capitalisation issues also suffered, with the market made even gloomier by the weakness last night in the Dow Jones and PLDT's ADR. PLDT fell in Manila by 20 pesos to 1,560, Petron dropped 0.40 to 8.20 while San Miguel fell 0.50 to 47.
Value turnover was heavy at 3.072 billion pesos.
Selling may continue next week due to prevailing negative sentiment, said Felix Barrientos of ING Barings Securities.
